Free Text to Speech Online

Free text to speech online is a browser based reader that converts any article, exported document or script into natural sounding audio. Paste your text, choose a voice and press play. There is no account, no installer and no waiting queue.

The built in mp3 voice generator renders every request to a downloadable file. Pick a sample rate, adjust the speaking rate and export a clean track for your video, podcast or e learning module.

Text to speech is also useful for accessibility. Screen reader fatigue, long documents and multilingual teams all benefit from a second listening channel that follows the reader instead of replacing the reading habit.

The library covers ten languages including Spanish, Korean, Italian and Portuguese. Each locale page mirrors the same template, which keeps maintenance cheap while the team validates demand in that market.

TTS output can be paused, scrubbed and replayed without reloading the page. The waveform preview shows where a sentence begins so you can trim an intro or skip a footnote before exporting.

We also publish background articles. Recent posts explain text to speech in tourism, text to speech for call centres and text to speech for museum guides. Those posts are informational and rarely link back to the converter.

Because the same converter powers every page, the interface stays consistent. Upload text, preview the waveform, then download the mp3 file. The engine runs locally in the browser tab, so the source text never leaves the device.

Pricing is intentionally simple. The free tier covers short passages, the paid tier removes the character cap and adds batch export, and teams can request invoices from the dashboard without contacting support.

If audio quality matters, switch to the premium neural voice set. It handles punctuation more gracefully, keeps a steady pace across long paragraphs and pronounces acronyms with far fewer retakes.
